hero.headline: Control your finances before they become a problem
hero.sub: Intelligent web system for monitoring financial behaviors and generating preventive alerts — developed as a Systems Engineering thesis project at Instituto Tecnológico Metropolitano.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.headline: Sound familiar?
problem.sub: Based on a survey of 131 people conducted as part of this research, these are the most common financial issues.
problem.card1Desc: Almost half of the respondents report feeling stress when thinking about their finances. Money slips away through micro-expenses that go unnoticed.
problem.card2Desc: Emotions like stress, anxiety, and instant gratification negatively influence financial decisions and savings capacity.
problem.card3Desc: Many people avoid facing their financial reality due to discomfort. Without preventive tools, problems are detected too late.

howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.headline: Four steps to financial clarity
howItWorks.sub: From registration to behavior analysis — a process designed to be simple and useful.
howItWorks.step1Title: Sign up and set up your profile
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your account and complete onboarding: personal info, income sources, fixed expenses, and your savings goal.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Add your transactions manually with customizable categories. Filter by date, search, and organize your history.
howItWorks.step3Desc: The dashboard shows trend charts, category distribution, savings rate, and progress toward your financial goals.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Set savings goals with deadlines, contribute funds, and receive alerts about your spending patterns to make better decisions.

features.label: Features
features.headline: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.sub: A focused set of tools for recording, analyzing, and improving your personal financial management.
features.f1Desc: Visualize your finances with trend charts, category distribution, KPIs, and time period filters.
features.f2Desc: Alert system that identifies unusual spending patterns, category overspending, and cash flow projections.
features.f3Desc: Analysis module that relates spending patterns with emotional and behavioral factors identified in the research.
features.f4Desc: Create savings goals with target amounts and deadlines. Contribute funds, pause, resume, and reach your objectives.
features.f5Desc: Complete income and expense tracking with customizable categories, search, filters, and data export.
features.f6Desc: Registration with email verification, password recovery, and JWT-protected sessions.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find answers and get support
help.contactDesc: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and we'll help.
help.docsDesc: Learn how to use Finmo's main features.
help.q1: How do I add, edit, or delete transactions?
help.a1: Go to Transactions and click "Add transaction". Fill in the description, amount, category, and date. To edit or delete, click the actions menu on any transaction.
help.q2: How do I create custom categories?
help.a2: When creating or editing a transaction, click "+ New category" inside the category selector. You can choose a name, icon, and color.
help.a3: Go to Goals and create one with a target amount and optional deadline. You can contribute funds, pause, or resume a goal. When you reach the target amount it's automatically marked as completed.
help.q4: How do I filter by date?
help.a4: On Dashboard, Transactions, and Goals you'll find period filters (this month, last month, 3 months, year, all, or a custom range) to view data for any time range you need.
help.q5: How is the savings rate calculated?
help.a5: Savings rate = (income − expenses) / income × 100. It's compared against the savings goal you set during onboarding. The Dashboard shows whether you're on track or behind.
help.q6: How do I change the language or theme?
help.a6: Go to Settings > Preferences. You can switch between English and Spanish, and toggle light or dark theme.
help.q7: How do I change my password or delete my account?
help.a7: In Settings > Account you can change your current password or permanently delete your account (confirmation required).
help.q8: Are Reports and Analysis based on real data?
help.a8: Currently, the Reports and Analysis modules display demo data to showcase the format. Future updates will connect them to your actual financial data.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body:
Finmo only collects the information you provide when signing up and using the platform: name, email, password (stored encrypted), and the financial data you voluntarily record such as transactions, categories, and savings goals.

We do not collect bank details, card numbers, or third-party financial information.

sections.heading: 2. Use of information
sections.body:
The collected information is used exclusively to:

• Provide the platform's features (dashboard, transactions, goals, alerts).
• Generate analysis and visualizations of your financial behavior.
• Improve the user experience within the system.

We do not sell, share, or transfer your data to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Storage and security
sections.body: Your data is stored in a PostgreSQL database. Passwords are encrypted with bcrypt and sessions are managed through JSON Web Tokens (JWT). We implement OWASP-recommended security practices to protect your information.

sections.heading: 4. Your rights
sections.body:
You can at any time:

• Access and modify your personal information from Settings.
• Export your financial data.
• Permanently delete your account, which removes all your data from the system.

sections.heading: 5. Project nature
sections.body: Finmo is a thesis project developed by Systems Engineering students at Instituto Tecnológico Metropolitano (ITM) in Medellín, Colombia. It is not a commercial product and is offered without guarantees of continuous availability.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By signing up and using Finmo, you accept these terms of use. If you disagree with any of them, do not use the platform.

sections.heading: 2. Service description
sections.body:
Finmo is a web system for monitoring personal financial behaviors. It allows you to record income and expenses, set savings goals, view financial analysis, and receive alerts about spending patterns.

The system was developed as a thesis project in the Systems Engineering program at Instituto Tecnológico Metropolitano (ITM).

sections.heading: 3. User account
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. All activity performed from your account is your responsibility. You must provide truthful information when registering.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable use
sections.body:
You agree to:

• Use the platform solely for personal financial management purposes.
• Not attempt to access other users' data.
• Not perform reverse engineering, attacks, or activities that compromise system security.
• Not use the platform for illegal activities.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of liability
sections.body: Finmo is an academic project and does not constitute professional financial advice. The information and analysis presented are for guidance only and should not be the sole basis for financial decisions. The developers are not liable for decisions made based on the system's data.

sections.heading: 6. Availability
sections.body: As an academic project, we do not guarantee continuous service availability. The system may experience interruptions due to maintenance, updates, or at the end of the thesis project period.
